name: localstore
description: Local tool store with development capabilities

scripts.backend: cd backend && (./.venv/bin/python app.py || python3 app.py || python app.py)
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n back,front -c blue,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.prod: npm run build && cd backend && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 FLASK_DEBUG=0 (./.venv/bin/python app.py || python3 app.py || python app.py)
